ideas.title: Trump Administration's $400 Million Minnesota Loan Fraud
ideas.description: The Trump administration has tightened Small Business loan regulations amid suspected fraudulent loans worth $400 million in Minnesota.
ideas.angle: Potential fraud and abuse of loan programs
questions: Who is involved in the fraud?
What are the implications for Minnesota?
ideas.insight: This story could expose large-scale abuse of loan programs and potential corruption.
